sourceData.meaningMnemonic: The <radical>bundle</radical> radical and the <kanji>bundle</kanji> kanji are the same!
sourceData.readingMnemonic: You should always <kanji>bundle</kanji> your <reading>sock</reading>s (<ja>そく</ja>). If you don't, there is a 100% chance you'll lose all of the left ones.
sourceData.readingInfo: Imagine doing laundry and making sure to bundle your socks together so none of them will be lost.
